research_role: External real-world IoT sensor temperature forecasting benchmark for MAD-TCN.
cold_chain_relevance: Analogue: Real ESP8266 sensor telemetry. Validates MAD-TCN generalization on physical hardware telemetry, but temperature range (21-51 C) represents indoor/outdoor ambient room conditions, not 0-5 C cold chains.
notes: Stored reverse chronologically in raw CSV; sorted chronologically during preprocessing. Contains 77,261 outdoor and 20,345 indoor observations.
